faq.question: Is this an official PUP website or service?
faq.answer: No. PUP San Pedro Campus is used only as a demo location. This website is not affiliated with, authorized by, or an official PUP service.

faq.question: How do I book?
faq.answer: Use the business-owned booking calendar once configured. Until then, submit a reservation request; it is only confirmed after the business confirms availability.

faq.question: How is my location used?
faq.answer: Your browser uses it only to calculate an approximate straight-line distance. Coordinates are not sent to this site or the AI assistant, and are not stored.
